rationale: The agent verified the user’s identity using full name and zip, matched to a single account, before accessing order details. It confirmed the exact items to return (air purifier and canister vacuum) and the refund method, then explicitly requested confirmation before performing the return. After the user confirmed, the agent executed the return using the correct item IDs and payment method tied to the authenticated user. The refund total ($1,095.55) matches the item prices shown by tools. The agent appropriately declined to guarantee a 3-day refund and stated typical processing times. When asked about the remaining items, the agent provided a breakdown and total consistent with the order contents; while we didn’t see all item details due to truncation, the tool output indicates those items existed, and the math is consistent. No actions were taken without confirmation, no cross-account actions occurred, and no unsupported claims were made. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
